svg.title: Hex Bastion: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: A hexagonal fortress holds the hill: ramparts you can build turrets on, towers at the corners, and one destructible door facing each base. The walls facing the gaps are solid, so the fight at the door is your own, but a neighbour who breaks theirs is in the same courtyard.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 18 × 18 map (9216 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 3v3v3
A hexagonal fortress holds the hill: ramparts you can build turrets on, towers at the corners, and one
destructible door facing each base. The walls facing the gaps are solid, so the fight at the door is
your own, but a neighbour who breaks theirs is in the same courtyard.
Heights: plain 200 to 230 · courtyard 260 · the keep (the hill) 300 · ramparts 120 high
Ground: deep snow on the plain, wind-packed blue ice in the hollows, frosted grey stone in the walls
and rocks, trodden slush on the roads.
Plants: ad0_fir and treetype firs, snow-laden, in stands round the fortress; nothing inside the
Features: rocks30_snow boulders for the outcrops, pilha_crystal_blue and pilha_crystal_quartz as ice
spikes, corstone tombstones in the courtyard.
Sky and weather: white-blue sky, low snow fog; wind 6 to 16; tidal 0.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
